title: Quickly Quenched British Provola Afternoon Tea Sandwich
description: A keto-friendly, fermented, flaky post-workout British dish featuring provola, inspired by Cornish cuisine, served as an afternoon tea sandwich with a ssam-wrap twist.
instructions: Preheat a panini press to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Butter one side of each ssam wrap.
On the unbuttered side of each ssam wrap, spread a layer of mayonnaise.
Top the mayonnaise with a slice of provola cheese, a sprinkle of crumbly cornish yarg cheese, and a few slices of fermented cucumber.
Add a dollop of pickle relish on top of the cucumber slices.
Season with salt, black pepper, and dried parsley.
Place the other ssam wrap, buttered side up, on top of the filling.
Cook in the panini press for 2-3 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and the ssam wrap is crispy.
Serve immediately and enjoy as an afternoon tea sandwich.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
